The **American College of Radiology** is the American radiological professional association — not to be confused with Danish organizations.[^src1] In the context of the Danish Acute Surgery Database (AKDB) evaluation, the organization is notable for publishing international clinical guidelines that inform national quality development efforts aimed at reducing mortality and improving diagnostic certainty in acute surgery.[^src1]

Specifically, the American College of Radiology recommends the use of contrast-enhanced abdominal CT scans for patients presenting with acute, non-localized abdominal pain, as well as for patients suspected of having an ileus.[^src1] These evidence-based recommendations directly support the clinical application and evaluation of [[indikator-3|Indikator 3]] (early CT scanning) within the Danish healthcare regions.[^src1]
